geometry_source: EU5 calibrated location geometry plus cited historical source maps/archaeological locators; no unresolved boundary is treated as an accepted aggregate target

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Ta'izz fiscal/crop district represented by the 692/1293 entries; no closed polygon is supplied by the accessible register sources.
crosswalks.resolution_method: Deterministic EU5 selector for the Ta'izz province is retained as a candidate sampling footprint only. No area-weighted historical overlap is asserted until the Rasulid district map is georeferenced.
required_actions: obtain or digitize the Rasulid Ta'izz district boundary
intersect the historical district polygon with calibrated EU5 location geometry
retain this record as a physical yield holdout even if the population-anchor gate remains closed
crosswalks.notes: The selector is not a population target and does not claim that all five EU5 locations share the register's land-quality classes. Sample-level yield ratios must remain attached to their original land-quality strata.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: The 124 villages/hamlets and canal/water-right entries listed in the al-Nabulusi register and settlement table; the source map uses a historical grid and points, not a closed aggregate polygon.
crosswalks.boundary_confidence: medium for the named Fayyum point; low for the complete 124-village aggregate
crosswalks.resolution_method: Retain the Fayyum EU5 tag as a candidate location-level feature join. Village and canal records remain a separate table until the project map grid is georeferenced and a complete historical-to-EU5 overlap is calculated.
required_actions: georeference FayyumMap1.pdf and Settlementtable.docx grid cells
map each village/canal record to calibrated EU5 polygons
keep poll-tax counts and fiscal levies in a physical/fiscal holdout table, never as total population
crosswalks.notes: A one-location selector is deliberately not a claim that the location covers the 124-village register. Coverage remains null until the historical map is digitized.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Archaeological Jenné-jeno and satellite-tell constellation within approximately 1 km of 13.88977 N, -4.54072 W; this is a validation locator, not a surrounding regional boundary.
crosswalks.boundary_confidence: medium for the archaeological coordinate/constellation; low for EU5 footprint coverage
crosswalks.resolution_method: Store the archaeological coordinate and a 1-km diagnostic geometry separately. Use the five-location selector only to identify candidate EU5 footprints for a later exact intersection; do not assign the 7,000-27,000 people to all five locations.
required_actions: obtain a digitized tell/settlement constellation polygon or archaeological site-area raster
intersect it with calibrated EU5 geometry
evaluate the wide population interval only as validation, preserving the 800-1100 out-of-period flag
crosswalks.notes: The site locator is useful for a local diagnostic, but an archaeological settlement population cannot supervise the carrying capacity of its modern EU5 province.
